keynums.label: Installed capacity - Fish Meal, Fish oil, Paste
Upcoming Oman facility - Fish Meal, Fish oil, Paste
Claimed market share in fish meal & fish oil revenue
Bengaluru leachate project capex / JV stake

bull_bear.body:
- Growth is pursued "continuously expanding via organic and inorganic opportunities" across India and Oman, executed mainly through majority (not always 100%) stakes in operating subsidiaries.
- Subsidiary stakes disclosed range from 31.34% (Pacific Marine) to 100% (Ento Proteins, Haris Marine), with several 51% acquisitions in 2025-2026; the deck also notes "Consolidation in Ocean Proteins by 11%".
- Recent capital commitments are small-ticket and bolt-on: Rs 11.1 crore (Delta Marine, 51%), up to Rs 15 crore (Aqua Marine, 51%), Rs 64.9 lakh (Swachha Eco Solutions, 25.98%), plus ~Rs 100 Cr capex on the Bengaluru leachate project.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Describes itself as "one of India's prominent manufacturers and exporters of fishmeal, fish oil, and fish-soluble paste" and claims a "~25-30% overall market share in revenue generated from fish meal and fish oil"; a separate business-overview page states "~25-30% share of Indian fish protein exports".
- Frames the business as a "Platform, Not a Commodity" - an integrated protein + waste + biotech model whose diversified revenues are said to reduce cyclicality, with 4 synergistic verticals forming one integrated platform.
- Claims high entry barriers "through regulatory approvals, execution depth, long-term contracts", and calls itself "Among India's largest exporters of fish meal and fish oil" and "India's First of its kind large scale BSF processor at MSW sites".
- Moat framed around certifications and traceability: acceptance under the MarinTrust Improver Programme (confirmed by Global Trust Certification (NSF), Ireland), plus GMP+ Feed, HACCP, ISO food-safety/quality, Export Inspection and a China Registered License.
- Customer stickiness claimed via "long-term export relationships", custom application-specific formulations and consistent 60-65% protein content.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Litigation] Resolved a long-standing customs matter with the Hon'ble CESTAT "setting aside the entire demand of approximately Rs 15.2 crore, along with associated interest and penalties".
- [Order win] Secured a contract from BBMP/BSWML for integrated animal waste management, alongside the Rs 474.89 crore legacy-leachate order from BSWML.
- [Group restructuring] Completed acquisition of ENTO and HMPPL into wholly owned subsidiaries (2026).
- [Industry backdrop] Deck cites Rabobank for an expected fishmeal shortage from 2028 and IFFO's view that novel feed sources become "essential, not optional"; policy tailwinds cited include Rs 2,761.8 Cr highest-ever fisheries allocation and Rs 2,500 Cr PM Matsya Sampada Yojana (Source: GOV PIB).
- [Leadership] Founder Chairman Mr. K Abdul Razak continues in an advisory capacity; MD & CEO, WTD & COO and WTD & CFO are all promoter-family members with 20-25+ years in the fishmeal industry.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Mukka Proteins as India's leading fishmeal/fish-oil manufacturer-exporter transitioning from a commodity marine-protein producer into a four-vertical "integrated animal protein & sustainability platform" spanning fish protein, insect (BSF) protein, waste management and frozen value-added seafood.
